# Mike
McCorriston
for City of Dublin Mayor
# Dublin Deserves More Transparency and Stronger Leadership.
Our city is growing - but too many residents feel left out of the decisions that shape our future. It's time for leadership that listens, plans responsibly, and delivers results.
MEET MIKE
GET INVOLVED
​
DONATE NOW
​
ENDORSE
## MEETING THE NEEDS OF OUR
DUBLIN COMMUNITY
I'm running for mayor because I believe Dublin can do better. We need leadership in city government that communicates openly, plans for the future with discipline, and puts residents - not special interests - at the center of every decision.
​
Dublin is a strong and vibrant community – but we are at a critical point.
​
Growth is accelerating. Decisions being made today will shape our quality of life for years to come. Many residents are asking for more transparency, better communication, and clearer long-term planning. ​We cannot afford to fall behind. This election is about ensuring Dublin remains a city that listens to its residents, plans responsibly, and protects the quality of life we all value.
​
Dublin’s strength comes from its people.
​
Our city is home to families from many cultures and backgrounds, including a growing Asian community that contributes enormously to our shared success. I am committed to ensuring every resident feels represented, respected, and included in shaping our future.
We have an opportunity to move Dublin forward – with leadership that is transparent, financially responsible, and accountable to the people. But it will take all of us.
​
As a current member of the Dublin City Council, former Mayor, and candidate for Mayor in the 2026 General Election, my priorities are:​
## Public Safety
## Fiscal Sustainability
## Housing Inclusivity and Affordability
## Economic Development and Small Business Support
## Infrastructure and Environmental Sustainability
